{{Quote|It was classic Imperial hubris|Suu in the Collected Interviews|<ref name="TFUII" />}}
[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] '''Kamer Suu''' was a defector from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]<ref name="TFUII" /> before or during [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]]<ref name="Date">The [[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II (graphic novel)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II'' comic]] places the events of ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]'' in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], so the events described in the in-game databank have to happen before or in 1 BBY.</ref> Suu spoke about the development of the [[Incinerator war droid]], and the conversation was recorded in the ''Collected Interviews of Captain Kamer Suu, Defector from the Empire''.<ref name="TFUII" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kamer Suu was first mentioned in the "Incinerator war droid" entry in the in-game databank of the [[Wikipedia:PlayStation 3|PlayStation 3]]/[[Wikipedia:Xbox 360|Xbox 360]] versions of [[LucasArts]]' [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]'', released in [[2010]].<ref name="TFUII" />
